runs.name: All metric scenarios · Rust e12daf8
runs.note: Latest Rust candidate e12daf8, two 60-second trials per vendor and scenario. Rollup and Combined were rerun together on fresh hosts after a local network outage; the other four scenarios share the original hosts. Pass-Through, Filter and Enrich use matched output batch sizes. Aggregate uses native behavior: Rust reduces over 10-second windows; OTel/Bindplane reduce labels within each batch. Rollup and Combined use 60-second intervals; output timing and volume can differ. CPU includes final delivery. This fixture has one metric with 512 points per request; mixed-metadata throughput is not measured.
